items.title: “我只希望 GTA 6 是同类游戏中的最后一款”：沃伦·斯佩克特 (Warren Spector) 祝贺 Rockstar 取得的里程碑式成就，但表示业界无法继续保持这种势头
items.summary: "I'd rather have hundreds of games and full employment than one game no matter how amazing it is."

content.v: Game industry legend Warren Spector retired in August , and somewhat ironically he's been more outspoken than ever about the state of the games industry. After blowing up over the closure of BioWare in October, he took a few weeks to think about it and got even more pissed off —and now he's shared some thoughts on the biggest videogame release of all time, Grand Theft Auto 6 .

Unlike the BioWare mess, Spector's not angry about GTA 6, but he's clearly ambivalent: His latest missive on LinkedIn opens with a congratulations to the dev team and says, "It looks like it will be a high point of sorts for our medium and our business," which right out of the gate suggests that he's not entirely upbeat about it.

Spector wasted no time getting to the point. "Its billion-dollar development cost and an undoubtedly crazy marketing budget don't represent a business model anyone else can or probably should emulate," he wrote. "That's especially true when thousands of developers are out of work. A billion dollars pays for a lot of games and a lot of salaries.
"Personally I'd rather have hundreds of games and full employment than one game no matter how amazing it is."

At the same time, he said GTA 6 demonstrates the truth of a point he's made previously: "Give a game the time and money to prove its potential (key word, potential) and you have a chance of making something great. Underfund a game or force it out the door before it's ready guaranteed failure no matter how much potential it has."

It's not hard to see that as a reflection on Thick as Thieves , the stealth game released earlier this year by Otherside Entertainment, where Spector served as chief creative officer and creative director prior to his retirement. Initially announced as a PvPvE game, Thick As Thieves was reworked and scaled back prior to its early access release, and eventually just ran out of money, time, and steam.

But it also characterizes the state of the game industry as a whole, where a select crop of proven winners—like GTA 6—from a tiny number of studios are given whatever resources they need to flourish, and everyone else scrabbles for crumbs. Former BioWare stalwart Trick Weekes predicted in September that Electronic Arts would be reduced to " guns and football " following its acquisition by Saudi Arabia's PIF, and so far he doesn't appear to be wrong .

In that light, Spector's ambivalence, and his conclusion, aren't hard to understand. "Again, congratulations. Ambition and innovation are necessary for the medium to reach its potential," he wrote. "I just hope GTA 6 is the last of its kind even if it's the best we have to offer."

items.summary: Grand Theft Auto games have been home to some weird phenomena over the years, and in GTA 6 , it looks like Big

content.v: Grand Theft Auto games have been home to some weird phenomena over the years, and in GTA 6 , it looks like Bigfoot is back and stinkier than ever. As the game steadily rolls out worldwide--or as people digitally immigrate to New Zealand for early access--streamers have been posting clips online of their encounters with the cryptid, and this time, it doesn't look like a man in a suit.

It looks like the Bigfoot sighting is tied to a mission in GTA 6, as the mysterious creature is wandering the woods of Leonida and it takes off in a panic when you encounter it. Another clip shows a strange encounter in the woods, with the player interacting with an effigy that emits noxious fumes and knocks them out. In a brief cutscene, Bigfoots, uh, really big feet, can be seen approaching Jason as he drifts in and out of consciousness.

In that first clip, Bigfoot is also covered in a cloud of fumes, which likely references stories about the mythical creature's potent stench. For GTA--and Red Dead Redemption--fans, this isn't the first time that they've been involved in a Bigfoot sighting, as encounters with it stretch back decades.

Back in 2004, rumors began to circulate about Bigfoot existing in GTA: San Andreas, but Rockstar dismissed these reports as false in 2005. A few years later, in Red Dead Redemption's Undead Nightmare expansion, protagonist John Marston was tasked with hunting down a pack of Sasquatches, and it was eventually revealed that the creatures were peaceful, capable of human speech, and now going extinct thanks to a certain trigger-happy cowboy.

Bigfoot would appear in GTA 5, as getting 100% completion in the game would unlock a new mission where co-protagonist Franklin hunts down a creature in Blaine Woods, only to discover it was a man in a costume . As an extra joke, the Bigfoot impersonator drops a few references to Red Dead Redemption's infamous encounter, but that doesn't mean the real Bigfoot isn't lurking in GTA 5. You could use the thermal scope on the sniper rifle supplied to you to spot a bipedal creature watching you during the "Predator" mission, and eating a golden Peyote plant under specific environmental conditions would turn players into Bigfoot.

Red Dead Redemption 2 brought an air of mystery back to the Bigfoot mythos, as you could find a gigantic skeleton half-buried in the snow high up on Mount Shann, and protagonist Arthur Morgan could also speak to an unseen figure that was heavily implied to be Bigfoot.
Meanwhile, you can check out our GTA 6 guides hub for more details on how to make the most out of your trip to Vice City.

content.v: I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .
Well, it's almost time. The big day is upon us: Grand Theft Auto 6 is here.

I mean, not here . We don't have it. But over in consoleland my understanding is the masses are—as we speak—building some sort of life-partnership with their new husband/wife. Also, doing crimes. Also, shooting kneecaps .

Which means it's almost time to end this journey. I think we can all agree: my hyper-modded version of GTA 5 is, if anything, much better than whatever nonsense Rockstar has people doing over in Vice City. Does Vice City have Crazy Taxi ? Does Vice City have roving bands of cougars ? Does Vice City have, uh, banking ? I think not.

And since my quest is so clearly, definitively complete, it's time to say goodbye. Almost. We'll actually properly say goodbye tomorrow, but for now, I have installed Farewell Journey – A Goodbye to GTA 5 , which bills itself as "One last day in Los Santos before moving on to GTA 6".

It's mostly a series of goodbyes between Franklin and pals before he boards a plane, for some reason, to Vice City. Or it should be. With the state my copy of GTA 5 is in, it all gets a bit… harder to parse. Please enjoy, and I will see you back here tomorrow for our own final farewell.

https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261119/1795018539_618363_jpg_r.jpg
技术制作总监Marc Chambers表示，《GTA6》是一项完全定制构建的项目，团队同时开发自己的工具与技术，目标是在不牺牲创作愿景的情况下交付完整体验。
技术高级副总裁Jonathon Ashcroft进一步说明，开发团队需要谨慎分配中央处理器和图形处理器使用的每一毫秒，同时维持游戏世界中的复杂模拟，并让大量相互作用的系统动态衔接。以30FPS运行时，每帧约有33毫秒可用于完成这些工作。
团队认为，这一帧预算能够在画面呈现、世界模拟和实际玩法之间取得合适平衡。相关说明并非断言主机绝对无法输出更高帧率，而是表明Rockstar基于当前游戏复杂度与开发目标，将有限算力用于系统模拟和整体表现，因此PS5 Pro也未增加面向高刷新率显示设备的40FPS模式。

items.title: 如何在 GTA 6 中获取安全代码
items.summary: Crack these vaults during a robbery to claim some cash.

content.v: GTA 6 safe codes will let you unlock sealed loot containers in the main story, but also during the lucrative robbery activity, which sees you knock over gang hideouts, banks, and other cash and contraband rich institutions.

The safe codes you need in the main story or specific missions are given to you, but in order to get a safe code during a robbery (and you'll need to because they're randomised), you have two main options:

First off, you can sometimes find the code written on something inside the store or bank, like a note on a board in the back office perhaps, or maybe a guard you've incapacitated is carrying it—press L3 and R3 to activate Focus Mode and help you find it.

You can also get the code by interrogating employees. Aim your weapon at them and use the "Threaten" or "Safe Code?" prompt shown on the screen to force them to give you the information. In certain robberies, this will also force cashiers to empty the register, as in previous GTA games.
Once you have the safe code, it will appear in the lower right corner of the screen when you're interacting with the safe. You'll have to enter the four-digit code to unlock it.

Time is of the essence, so the faster you can get the code, the quicker you can open the safe and load the cash into your bag. You can tell if an establishment has a safe by selecting it on your map, which will also give you some idea of the security level (low to high) and the approximate value of the goods, so you can pick a lucrative target for your next stick up.

items.title: GTA 6：最快的赚钱方法
items.summary: Sometimes the best thing a criminal can do is steal from other criminals.

content.v: There's a lot of ways to make money fast in GTA 6 , from robbing jewelry stores, pawn shops, and banks to boosting cars, winning races, and even mugging strangers. But some jobs are more lucrative than others, and sometimes the payoff of a big heist isn't worth the time, prep work, and violence it takes to complete them. If you need some cash fast and easy, here are some ideas that are mostly low risk, high reward. Heck, a couple of them aren't even illegal!
1. Rob other criminals
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/AfT7Ty88gKDsUub2xbssGD-1920-80.jpg
Here's the best bit of advice you're going to get for making money in GTA 6: steal from your fellow thieves.

As you're out and about in the world, you'll often see a crime in progress: a bank robbery taking place, a jewelry store heist happening, an armored car being jacked, a drug deal down at the docks, or sometimes just a speeding vehicle filled with criminals fleeing from pursuing cops.

Hit those criminals. Hard and fast. And then take their shit . Especially in Chapter 2 and Chapter 3, another criminal's sack of bills or jewels or drugs is worth lots more than the take you'll get from hitting most robbery locations yourself. If you see crooks fleeing with duffel bags over their backs, drop 'em. (You can do it non-lethally if you like, but drop 'em.)

Then grab their bags and beat cheeks because the heat that was on them will quickly be on you. Some robbery crews will have multiple bags of goods, so best to travel as a couple, Lucia and Jason, if only to be able to carry off all that re-stolen loot and cash it in with a fence. You don't want to leave a sack of cash or jewelry behind, right? And if you act quickly enough, you'll be able to make a clean getaway.

When you're out exploring Leonida, keep your ears open at all times. Hear sirens? Alarms? Gunshots? Screams? Cars speeding or crashing? Don't hesitate. Take out the other crew and grab the loot for yourself. It's usually a great payday.
2. Steal cars
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/an5qCscgc9CwmyWVCooJ2D-1920-80.jpg

Okay, a pretty obvious one, but once you hit Chapter 2 and meet a mechanic, Moses, who gives you a slim jim and will buy stolen cars, it's probably the best way to turn a quick profit for relatively little risk. A decent car (Moses is looking for older model, low profile cars) will usually net you between one and a few thousand dollars, which is better than most smash-and-grab jobs you'll be doing at that stage and way easier to pull off. This is because Moses pays well and the fence you have in Chapter 2 does not.

The only drawback to Moses is that once he buys a stolen car, you can't sell him another for a bit. There's a big plus, though: he will often tell you precisely where the cars he's looking for are located. Randy, your car fence starting in Chapter 3, will pay way more because he's after higher end, much flashier cars.
3. Demolition Derby at Ambrosia Raceway
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/zvDuuxmLCYLeFkh6tej3HD-1920-80.jpg

There are lots of races with nice payouts in GTA 6, but what if, like me, you're a terrible driver? The demolition races at Ambrosia Raceway are just the thing for those of you who tend to crash a lot anyway. Win on the oval track and you'll make over three grand, and it's double the take on the figure-eight track. Plus, you can repeat the races as many times as you like. Easy money.

The secret is, you come in first by default when all the other cars have been destroyed. If you can't beat 'em, just ram 'em, flip 'em, and destroy 'em. You don't even need to use your own wheels, just rent one from the track for a few hundred, spend a couple minutes slamming your front fender into everyone you see, and pocket the winnings long before you've done the eight laps.
4. Hunting
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/RhvWHU4evhfwzJZHvrByED-1920-80.jpg

The hunting payouts aren't huge at first, but as you start taking on hunting missions for your old military buddy Bret in Lummox County in Chapter 2 (these missions are for Jason only), he'll request you hunt creatures that he'll pay more and more for. Like Red Dead Redemption 2, there are legendary animals in GTA 6, and that means money.

You can take down the animals from Bret's lists or just find your own prey out in the world. Just today I was exploring, spotted a large boar in the woods, grabbed my rifle from my truck, and shot it: Bret paid me $2,500 and even came to pick up the carcass himself, saving me a trip. For smaller trophies, just park outside and step into Bret's building, and he'll auto-buy the dead critters right out of your trunk. Good deal.
5. Robbing stores with back doors
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/cJzBTfpfhiEthMEfnToL5D-1920-80.jpg

Your entire criminal strategy will change in Chapter 3 when you get a tool called the snap gun. This lets you pick door locks, which means bypassing alarms. From then on, make sure the places you want to rob have a back door: it's the key to turning a quick smash-and-grab into a proper heist.

Coming in the back of the store is the way to do crime: you get inside without anyone (usually) immediately noticing, can quickly and quietly subdue any security or employees hanging around in the rear of the store, get quick access to the security footage (destroy it) and the alarm system (disable it) and can locate the safe before anyone knows a heist is going down.

With alarms off and your partner doing crowd control, you can take the time to make sure you're getting every penny out of the place. Smash every jewelry display case. Threaten someone for the safe code or find it written down somewhere in the office. Empty all the cash drawers, even take people's wallets and the drugs from first-aid kits. Do it right and you can make a clean getaway, avoiding the police pursuit altogether. Beautiful.
6. Pilot Pete's drops
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2GkGGcCWCUK4SmBWAmWEHD-1920-80.jpg
You'll meet a pilot in Chapter 3 and he'll start offering you regular work in Chapter 4. Get in your flying practice, though: these are time-sensitive jobs.

Pete will direct you to his plane and you'll use it to distribute cocaine around Leonida by dropping packages to buyers waiting below. You'll have multiple targets to hit across the map, and a time-limit: those buyers won't hang around forever, waiting. (I guess they have something more important to do than acquiring huge bricks of coke?) Fly smart and plot your route efficiently and you'll make a nice chunk of change from each run.
Other money-makers
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WupBLNoLkWTWcyn8GQ3JbW-1920-80.jpg
There are, naturally, lots of other ways to make money, but most come with more risk, more time, or less of a haul.

items.title: 别指望在 GTA 6 中很长时间就能看到罪恶都市
items.summary: For those still waiting for GTA 6 to unlock, it's possible you have something of a mistaken impression of what

content.v: For those still waiting for GTA 6 to unlock, it's possible you have something of a mistaken impression of what the early hours will look like. Despite partially sharing a setting with GTA Vice City, you should not expect to be walking up the game's equivalent of Ocean Drive and Miami Beach in the opening minutes, as in the 2002 game. Far from it.

As we noted in our video discussion on why we gave GTA 6 a 10/10 in our review , Tamoor and Jake did some expectation-setting. Rather than starting the game in Vice City, you'll instead spend the opening hours in a smaller corner of the state of Leonida, Key Lento. Vice City is undoubtedly the crown jewel of the game's world, but it could be as much as 20 hours before you reach it, depending on how you play.

This seems to be a deliberate decision that, as Tam says, allows you to progress through the world at roughly the same pace as the ambitions of co-stars Lucia and Jason. The opening area may not be as glamorous as Vice City, but it is no less detailed than the rest of the game. It's possible it's only meant to last you around 5-6 hours, but we found it easy to get lost spending far more time than that, which resulted in Tam not reaching Vice City until after 15 or 16 hours.

Key Lento provides a good look at how the game and its simulation work, letting you eventually progress to a much larger space (seriously, the map is huge ) with a good understanding of how things work.
All of this is to say, the glitz and glamor of Vice City are waiting for you--eventually. To make the most of the opening hours, be sure to check out our guide on what to do in GTA 6 first .

items.title: 杰森喜欢 GTA 6 中的猫，但不是所有的猫
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 co-protagonist Jason is, like many Americans, a fan of cats. Naturally, being an open-world

content.v: Grand Theft Auto 6 co-protagonist Jason is, like many Americans, a fan of cats. Naturally, being an open-world game with seemingly endless possibilities, GTA 6 does indeed let Jason express that love by petting cats he sees. However, not every cat is down to be pals with Jason.

As shared on social media, if you're walking around Leonida and spot a friendly-looking cat, you can go give it a pet. Jason even talks to the cat, because you'd have to be a monster not to, and the action even gives him a little focus boost.

But not all cats are the same. Another clip shared online shows Jason carjacking someone, as one does in GTA. After driving away, loud meowing can be heard, and the camera cuts to inside the car as a cat viciously attacks Jason. A quicktime event is necessary to get the cat to stop, at which point Jason is able to stop the car and let the cat out.

We can only imagine what would happen if that were a Rottweiler in the back seat of that car and not a sort-of-large cat. There are plenty of other animals to kill you while you're roaming Vice City and the rest of Leonida in Grand Theft Auto 6, and most of those would be less embarrassing to mention in your obituary than "cat."
Grand Theft Auto 6 is one of the most expansive and detailed games ever made, and if you're looking for some help, you can check out our GTA 6 guides hub as well as our guide on what to do first .

In GameSpot's GTA 6 review , Tamoor Hussain said, "This game is the culmination of everything the developer has previously achieved in the open-world space that pushes the genre to heights that, in all likelihood, no other developer will be able to reach. GTA 6 is an astonishing open-world action game that I'd wager won't be outdone until Grand Theft Auto 7," ultimately awarding it a 10/10 score .

items.title: 飞越整张 GTA 6 地图需要多长时间？
items.summary: The Grand Theft Auto 6 map is absolutely massive , gigantic, and at least one more synonym to encapsulate its

content.v: The Grand Theft Auto 6 map is absolutely massive , gigantic, and at least one more synonym to encapsulate its size accurately. Whether it's land, sea, or air, covering it is going to take a lot of time, but just how many hours should you set aside for a flight across Leonida?
We found out for ourselves by piloting a single-propeller plane across the map, which took us an entire four minutes and 10 seconds between the two points on the map. That's pretty big!

We've known for a while that the GTA 6 map was going to be big--with roughly more playable space than GTA 4, GTA 5, and Red Dead Redemption 2 combined --but even that claim doesn't put into perspective just how enormous the game truly is until you experience it for yourself. Another fascinating tidbit is that escaping GTA 6 is nigh-impossible , but definitely worth attempting.

As one streamer has discovered, if you try to cheese it on water using a jet ski, you'll run out of fuel and be left stranded in the water. There might be a happy ending to this scenario, as some streamers have posted clips of a dog on a wave runner coming to their rescue. We've tried to replicate this ourselves, but we've had no luck yet.

But if you choose to stay within Leonida's invisible boundaries, you won't run out of things to do for quite some time. Between missions to improve your lot in life, pursue relationship goals, and soak up the scenery, the reactive open world of GTA 6 will keep you entertained for hours. Our GTA 6 review gave the game a rare 10/10 score, and dozens of other reviewers worldwide have also been very impressed with what Rockstar Games has achieved.

You can experience all of that for yourself soon, and if you're not planning to do some digital tourism with a long walk, check out our GTA 6 guides hub for all kinds of walkthroughs to help you survive and thrive in the game.

items.title: Clair Obscur：《Expedition 33》的首席编剧已离开 Sandfall，帮助游戏开发者讲述更好的故事
items.summary: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33’s lead writer has left Sandfall to help other game developers think about story fr

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/03/13/clairthumb-1741875039872.png

Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 ’s lead writer has left Sandfall to help other game developers think about story from the outset. Jennifer Svedberg-Yen, the narrative lead for Expedition 33, won a BAFTA Breakthrough U.S. award earlier this year, and she’s since been consulting on stories across the industry.

Expedition 33 was her first video game (she came from a career in private equity), but it won more than 400 awards and received almost universal critical acclaim, in part due to its blend of real-time and traditional turn-based RPG mechanics, and partly because of its mysterious story, strong emotional beats, and brilliant characters.
Svedberg-Yen is now setting up a fund with the aim of advancing narrative design in video games and nurturing new writing talent.

“I feel that we are losing so much institutional knowledge,” Svedberg-Yen told GamesBeat . “We’re making it extraordinarily difficult for a younger generation of developers to have formative experiences. There’s so much disruption in the industry right now.”
Outside of the constant layoffs and upheaval in the industry, there’s also a sense, still, that narrative isn’t as respected as other parts of game design.
“A lot of studios think of narrative as a skin,” Svedberg-Yen said. “They think you can bring someone in later to make everything make sense.
“But when you start from the beginning, everyone is building from the same story and the different disciplines naturally reinforce each other.”

The award-winning writer believes this approach limits what games can achieve. Expedition 33 was designed with a narrative-first approach, with the game systems built around the story to reinforce the themes and pace the big moments out.

“Narrative was king,” she said. “It was always a narrative-first game. I think that’s why we were able to achieve the results that we did in terms of integrating all the different pieces into a wonderful collaborative whole. There was that consistency from the very beginning.”
According to Svedberg-Yen, she’s received messages from players about how Expedition 33 helped them deal with grief and navigate the world after suffering a personal loss.

Unfortunately, it doesn’t seem like we’ll see more of Svedberg-Yen’s work in video games any time soon. Outside of the fund, she has a couple of ideas for TV, but she left Sandfall in July “after wrapping up some final stuff for Expedition.”

Following success at pretty much every major video game award show (most recently including scooping up Best Game at the BAFTA Awards ), Sandfall Interactive is now busy planning its next project. Details of that currently remain under wraps, though the suggestion is that it will be another adventure set in the same Clair Obscur universe .

"Wearing its inspirations on its sleeve, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 paints itself into the pantheon of great RPGs with a brilliant combat system and a gripping, harrowing story," IGN wrote in our Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 review , dubbing it a "modern RPG classic."

这一设计与游戏的任务结构及世界状态变化有关。玩家的选择可能产生不同结果，同一情境既可能平稳推进，也可能演变为混乱局面， 开放世界 中的随机事件同样会受到此前选择影响。

items.summary: 距离NVIDIA的RTX Spark上市，已经过去33天。 此前的文章 里，我已经简单聊过它的性能表现。但在那之后，一个问题反而一直留在我脑子里： 我们到底需要用本地部署的AI模型来做什么？ 和云端大模型相比，本地模型的

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14649/94519a3396ad47698148bf62f627f318.jpg_mw680water
距离NVIDIA的RTX Spark上市，已经过去33天。 此前的文章 里，我已经简单聊过它的性能表现。但在那之后，一个问题反而一直留在我脑子里：
我们到底需要用本地部署的AI模型来做什么？
和云端大模型相比，本地模型的优势其实已经不新鲜了——隐私得到保护，使用不依赖网络，也不需要每次调用都付出额外的API成本。但这些优势似乎还不足以成为普通人非本地模型不可的理由。
直到上周，我去了一趟上海英伟达办公室。现场用多台RTX Spark笔记本电脑和RTX Spark 紧凑型桌面主机（SFF），部署本地模型并展示了多个落地Demo，让我意识到本地AI的价值不是替代云端大模型，而是让AI向我们的日常生活再走一步。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14649/7054a7710d7bd4cfa593d50f62ab209e.jpg_mw680water
我们在现场看到了华硕和机械革命的两款RTX Spark紧凑型桌面主机
先说说游戏吧。现场展示的几款游戏中，《伊莫》对本地模型的应用给我的印象最深。
这项功能放在了《伊莫》的家园系统里，玩家可以通过语音指令，和自己放在家园里小伊莫进行互动，命令他们去种植作物、建造设施、或是完成挖矿浇水这样的简单工作。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14649/a3b4b5572bedee6c284e59ea51420957.jpg_mw680water
这些事情看起来并不复杂，但恰恰因为任务范围有限，一个本地小模型就足以支撑这样的交互。玩家说一句话，伊莫就可以根据指令做出对应动作，也可以通过动作和表情回应玩家。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14649/01fbae018b577fde22556d9154b95538.jpg_mw680water
还可以让它们到你眼前集合，分别“表演才艺”
从技术角度看，这或许只是一个并不复杂的AI应用；但从玩家体验来说，它提供的是一种很直接的“情绪价值”——游戏里的伙伴开始真正听懂你，并且可以为你分担一些琐碎操作了。
这和几年前大模型刚出现时很像。
一开始，我们也会问“AI到底能拿来干什么？”。但现在，人们已经在写作、搜索、办公、编程等使用场景中离不开AI了。本地AI也许同样正处在这样一个阶段——技术已经准备好了，只是我们还没有养成对应的使用习惯。
当本地模型不再被限制在“小伊莫”这样的游戏角色里，它其实还能做更多事情。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14649/0913c7dd045169051f6c87af379a507e.jpg_mw680water
由“特效小哥”团队带来了机器人Demo
现场的创作者中有人提到，他已经在用本地模型批量完成照片的基础调色工作；对于像我这样经常采访录音的人来说，也会通过本地模型对录音文件进行转写、整理和关键词分类。
但真正给我带来启发的，是现场的一个机器人Demo。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14649/92487831cf900e36f7852564acb54695.jpg_mw680water
Microduck是Hugging Face今年推出的一个开源机器人。它能走路、踢球、滑行，摔倒后还能自己重新站起来，也可以通过强化学习训练新的动作。
在现场，这只鸭子的“大脑”并不在机器人身体里，而是放在旁边的一台RTX Spark笔记本里。通过Wifi网络，机器人把数据传回来，本地模型负责处理和整理，最终让机器人动起来。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14649/ae2072dbf194108a2396b9287833926e.gif_mw680
这个过程最有意思的地方在于，它并没有要求使用者先成为机器人专家。
现场的一位工作人员告诉我，直到几天前他也不了解机器人该怎么玩，对机器人的电机等专业知识更是毫无了解。但他通过搭建工作流，让本地小模型负责采集整理数据、大模型来分析并下达指令，给自己搭建出了一套“从零开始玩转机器人”的流程。
这可能才是本地AI最值得关注的地方。我之前思考的，都是本地模型能放进哪些已有的生活场景里，但是在它的帮助下，我们其实能创造更多使用它的生活场景。比如在现场，还有另一个团队带来了一套教学授课的机械臂学习方案，同样依托于本地模型实现。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14649/1e91fa3f7a78ccd7cf3b8b3785ea5dd1.jpg_mw680water
所以现在回头看，我觉得我们讨论本地AI时，或许不应该一直纠结“它能跑多大的模型”，反而应该多去想想怎样让它适配到更多生活场景里。
云端大模型更像一个擅长思考的大脑，处理复杂的问题、进行长链路推理、帮助我们制定计划。而本地小模型更像是与外界接触的“神经末梢”，它负责听见、看见、感知周围的变化，处理那些不值得专门“问一次大模型”的琐碎任务。
我们已经学会了把AI当做一颗外置大脑，随着RTX Spark这样的设备逐渐普及，它们对本地模型的支持，也一定会让我们逐渐学会把AI当做另一只手臂，去触摸那些我们现在还未想象过的生活。

电影院除了放电影，还能干什么？
11月14日晚，2026年王者荣耀KPL年度总决赛第五局，此时JDG与WB战至2比2平，意味着谁先拿下这局，谁就抢先一步拿到赛点。
比赛进行到大概12分钟，此时JDG已经落后近7k经济，只能放任WB进入己方蓝区，并退至二塔龟缩防守。关键时刻，JDG游走位无畏的赵怀真抓住机会，闪现拉住对方双C，中路清融的不知火舞立刻闪现跟进开团，最终在大劣的局势下打出了一记漂亮的反击。
伴随着解说的惊叹，耳边响起的是吼声和此起彼伏的尖叫。这些声音，一部分来自音响，那是比赛现场观众的欢呼声：另一部分则来自我身旁的座位，甚至有人站起身挥动双手呐喊助威。一时之间，我几乎无法分辨声音出自哪边。
此时，我正坐在深圳儒意电影旗下的一家寰映影城中，与KPL年度总决赛的举办场地成都凤凰山体育公园综合体育馆是字面意义上的千里迢迢。但是，面对眼前的巨大幕布，听到身边观众热烈地讨论比赛、尽情呐喊尖叫，我时不时还是会产生自己身处现场的错觉。
不得不说，这可能是我至今在电影院这个场合所感受过的最“热闹”、也最激动人心的一次“观影经历”了。
今年是KPL创立的第十年，举办场地选在了《王者荣耀》的诞生地成都。
但是，能够“线下”观看这场比赛的机会其实不止在成都 。今年儒意电影也与KPL开启了“十年荣耀，顶峰相见”全域跨界联动，总决赛当晚，儒意电影在旗下全国50家影城开设了官方第二现场，让玩家能够在影院的大屏下集体观赛、线下助威。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14647/7bda2068bdb8bbddadc45a2aedd03acb.jpg_mw680water
也正是在这其中的一家影院，我和满场玩家一同观赛，看着JDG与WB打满七局，最后WB以4:3获胜，拿下队史第四个冠军。
整场观赛过程中，最先让我感到好奇的是我右手边的一位男生。相比其他人，他总表现得稍稍沉默，也更克制，少有呼喊出声的时候，他另一边的男生，还时不时转过头来，向他解释不同的选手各有什么特征，双方队伍又擅长怎样的战术体系。
好奇之下自然是一番攀谈，我这才知道，他们一行共五人是大学同学，又因为大多自小接触《王者荣耀》，便因为游戏结成关系更紧密的“固排搭子”。他本身其实看KPL不多，对战队、选手也不是很熟悉，但他旁边的另一位男生是KPL的忠实观众，既然有人提出要来影院线下观赛，大伙就都一起来了。而在BP博弈、或是战况激烈的时刻，那位男生也总不忘向他讲解：“这个选手总是这样……”
至于为什么不去现场而是选择影院，另一位男生有点不好意思地告诉我，飞去成都观赛的成本确实有点高，不是大家都负担得起，反倒是在影院，大家可以随便相约，“看完一起回宿舍”。
当然，也有很多玩家，是怀着更为复杂的情绪来到影院观赛。
影院的最后一排有一对观众，我本以为是一同前来观赛的情侣，结果询问后才知道，他们其是表兄妹的关系，表妹2024年才开始接触《王者荣耀》，当时被研究生同学一起拉着开始看KPL，结果迅速发展为她繁忙学业中的重要消遣活动。
聊起KPL，她几乎是滔滔不绝地向我描述起她最喜欢的“狼队”，从最开始被实力圈粉，一路追过的大小比赛，甚至于去年鸟巢线下观看狼队和AG的总决赛——也正是因为去年的那场比赛，狼队最终2：4遗憾输给AG，导致她觉得又难过又“亏”。今年的KPL总决赛没有狼队，她又割舍不下自己的电竞情怀，干脆拉着同样玩王者的表哥一起来影院观赛。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14647/8835c51ba0e80a778065da272faf074e.jpg_mw680water
去年KPL总决赛在鸟巢举办
不同人来到影院观看KPL的原因各不相同。比如我碰到一对Coser打扮的女生，她们因为扩列认识，其中一位明年就要出国读书，决定今年来线下看一次KPL；另一位女生已经将近3年没玩过《王者荣耀》，却是KPL的忠实观众，同时是JDG选手清融的铁粉，第六局比赛JDG取胜，把比分扳成3：3平，她一边尖叫一边看着手表捂嘴：“我心跳都130了！”
我想，不论什么理由，当所有人同处影厅，同时被幕布上的赛事牵动着心思时，不论成都或深圳，不论现场或是“第二现场”，大家的情绪是共通的。
自2016年创立以来，KPL一直是移动电竞圈层标杆级的职业联赛。赛事规格不断升级、社会认可度不断提高的同时，玩家之间的凝聚力也在同步增长。能够汇集如此多的玩家在电影院观赛，也说明了KPL不止是为玩家贡献共同的话题，也实打实地把更多玩家聚到一起，产生更紧密的联系。
比赛结束，影院散场时，我在不少观众那看到本次KPL的联名周边——这次儒意电影和KPL展开合作，不仅是决赛夜的观战，早在国庆期间，北京、上海、广州、深圳、成都、杭州六座城市的六家影城已经陆续换上了KPL主题“皮肤”， 联名内容出现在儒意电影全国700多家直营影城的映前广告和大屏上，各类联名周边则直接摆进影城柜台出售。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14647/6e6aa3f50857bab956215e4d037d9247.png_mw680water
和线上观赛相比，他们切实地留下了一些物件。在直播间关闭后，一张票根，或是某个亚克力挂件，会被他们带回家。今后看到，或是摸到这些东西时，可能还会回想起这个在影院度过的热烈的决赛夜。
根据儒意电影公布的数据，这次联动为万达影城APP及小程序带来了约45万新增用户；仅国庆假日期间，联名商品就卖出了100多万件，活动曝光量超过2亿次。这些数字背后，有不少人可能是第一次因为看电影以外的理由走进影院。
但对儒意电影来说，赛事直播其实并不是新业务。
2025年5月底，F1西班牙大奖赛在全国6城6家IMAX影院直播，北京万达影城CBD万达广场店是其中之一，这也是全球首场在IMAX影院直播的F1赛事。英雄联盟LPL总决赛已经连续几年登上大银幕，今年影院场次排在凌晨，票依然难抢。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14647/a7b11c4b6a1a84c4e57d639272e63bd7.png_mw680water
归根结底，赛事内容自带仪式感和情感共鸣，放到公共空间里，这些感受也会被放大。观众来到现场，追求的不仅是赛事内容本身，还有“同好聚会”的体验。
当然，如果仅凭各类赛事，那么能够服务的观众数量依然有限，很难形成稳定的内容供给。或许是察觉到这一点，儒意电影今年也开始把各种零散的尝试变成体系，搭建一套自有的内容矩阵。 这里说的"自有"，不是指每一份内容都由自己生产。关键在于运营能力：选什么内容、怎么排场、在影厅里怎么呈现，这些由影院自己掌握。
首先要变的是供给逻辑。今年6月的战略发布会上，儒意影视提出“全球内容开放合作模式”，从“供给驱动”转向“供给+需求驱动”，院线全年拿出10%到20%的排片做多元化放映，最直观的例子便是其4月推出的“拼好片”。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14647/344b9410865aacb42d23a494fa78eb94.png_mw680water
顾名思义，“拼好片”就是用户投票"许愿"，儒意电影按行业规则引入片源，拼团成功后排场放映。官方的说法是，要“在某一座城市、某一个时间点，为共同喜爱某一部影片的那些观众完成一场放映”。到今年9月，6部由全国用户票选出的电影已经正式通过这一模式登上大银幕。

内容品类也在这个过程中被补全，拼凑出这张“自有内容矩阵”的大致轮廓：剧集方面，《黑夜告白》通过"拼好片"在十座城市做了直播连线见面会，活动上线12小时就有20万用户预约；综艺方面，影院落地了《歌手》直播现场；动漫方面，其8月和腾讯视频合办的动漫大赏在北京、上海、广州、成都等10个城市放映了100多场，平均上座率达到九成；晚会方面，9月20日的"湾区升明月"2026大湾区电影音乐晚会，儒意电影是独家影院第二现场，没能去到现场的观众坐在自己城市的影厅里，跟着屏幕应援、合唱……
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14647/b5503f1e621f830beb92f32c2399fab1.jpg_mw680water
游戏联动如今是相对成熟的一块。其专门搭建的IP内容池“游戏联运池”目标是将影院打造成玩家的第二现场，过去两年已合作过《王者荣耀》《原神》《恋与深空》《光与夜之恋》《第五人格》《鸣潮》等多款游戏，据称带来了300万25岁以下的新客群。
内容形态在改变，影厅的角色也跟着变。过去影厅只负责“播片”，放完观众就离场；现在影城还要配套做周边、布置主题场景、组织应援和互动。像儒意电影今年提出的“新五感”体验标准中，“社交感”就是通过同好互换、观赛活动、动漫市集等，“让陌生人因热爱而相聚”。
影城大堂的变化则更加直观。儒意电影投资的潮玩品牌52TOYS已经进驻旗下402家国内影城，货架上既有自研潮玩IP，也有各类联名盲盒；智能大头贴"拍立方"则落地了305家影城，尝试先用拍照打卡把观众吸引过来，再往观影上转化。
今年6月推出的“六星影城”进一步把这些元素集中到一起，官方定位是"先锋、稀缺、独特体验"的城市潮流文化地标。“六星影城”中包括IMAX珍稀海报展墙、时光里潮流集成店和IP联名打卡区。到今年第三季度，全国已有30家六星影城挂牌，覆盖27座重点城市。官方披露的品牌净推荐值达87%，年复购率超过56.8%。
沿着这条路往下走，大众对于“电影院”的固有印象或许也会松动：在未来，电影院可能成为一个不去看电影，反倒为了与人相会的地方。
结语
回想起在电影院观看2026 KPL决赛的夜晚，我还能想起很多与KPL关系不大的事情。有个女生零食买了太多吃不完，问我要不要分点；那个看起来有点沉默的男生告诉我，除了陪朋友玩王者，他在《影之刃零》发售第三天就通了关，最近刚结束二周目；还有那位表哥，现场掏出自己的NS2，说前段时间刚玩完塞尔达“王泪”，现在往前补上旷野之息。
我想，这场比赛之后，还会有更多各种各样的人走进这个影厅，凑在一起谈天说地。他们相聚的契机、各自的喜好或许不同，但可以肯定的是，彼此的距离被影厅切实地拉近了。
以影城为据点，以社交为纽带，不难发现儒意电影正在构建一套全新的文娱生态架构。放眼将来，电影院或将重新定义一代年轻人的文化娱乐生活。

*咕咕嘎嘎题头图为AI生成
年底了，又到了一年一度的游戏圈“年底颁奖季”。
每逢11月中下旬，全球各大主流奖项与平台年度榜单便开始扎堆揭晓。昨天TGA 2026提名名单刚刚出炉，中国游戏便迎来了集体爆发的高光时刻：除了《影之刃零》杀入“年度最佳游戏”等5项核心提名外，在“最佳移动游戏”的五个席位里，以《明日方舟：终末地》为代表的国产产品更是一口气占下了四席。
站在年终岁尾的节点，大家往往都带着几分看热闹的心态在等待：经历了近一年的大浪淘沙后，究竟哪款产品能鲜花着锦。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14645/d3301c5713de62555b446e3491bdc97c.png_mw680water
而北京时间昨晚十一点，Google Play已经率先交出了自己的2026年度最佳榜单——而在最终揭晓的名单里，《明日方舟：终末地》无疑也成了赢家：它一口气将 全球“年度最佳游戏（Best of 2026）”与多地区“最佳剧情游戏（Best Story Game）” 两项重量级大奖收入囊中。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14645/d373e90a4b1aaccb2e2faa277e3bf420.png_mw680water
现在，距离这款作品在今年1月开启全球公测，才刚刚过去快十个月。
犹记得年初游戏刚端上桌那会儿，行业内外还在围着“我也要拉电线吗”的复合玩法争论不休，猜测这款带着一定实验色彩的“异类二游”接下来会如何如何，转眼到了年底，无论是商业还是口碑层面，恐怕都没什么太大的质疑声可说了。
Google Play这座年度奖杯，也是相当有含金量的：举个例子，去年拿下全球年度最佳的是PTCGP（宝可梦卡牌手游）这种含着金汤匙出生的世界级国民IP；另一方面，Google Play的评选重心向来聚焦于不含日韩的欧美等全球T1市场，极其看重一款产品在非本土文化圈里的“硬通货”成色。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14645/f3e0b3f59706816cefecdad1d7050147.png_mw680water
而在Google官方给出的颁奖词里，给了一段相当高的评价：“……《 明日方舟：终末地》的每一处都让我们着迷。流畅爽快的即时战斗、鲜活立体的角色，以及颇具深度的工厂建造与经营玩法，共同带来了独一无二的游戏体验，令我们久久难忘。 ”
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14645/c2c9e0521b26b5d30818390c681f69c3.png_mw680water
换作年初的时候，我大概率会觉得， 终末地 底子里那套浓郁的中式底色与工业美学，放在全球市场多少会有些天然的认知门槛。但这次能同时把“年度最佳”和最吃文化共鸣的“最佳剧情”收入囊中，只能说明全球玩家和评委是真的玩进去了。
不过话又说回来，奖，终末地今年确实已经拿得让人有点“审奖疲劳”了。

在研发阶段，终末地先斩获了TGS 2024的“未来期待奖”；今年1月公测刚落地，转身就捧回了PlayStation玩家选择奖的开年最佳新游；紧接着，它又入围了向来以严苛、挑剔著称的Apple设计大奖（ADA）“视觉和图像”类别——甚至也是今年所有奖项里唯一入围的中国游戏产品；到了夏天去欧洲腹地参加科隆游戏展，拿下了“最佳移动游戏”提名，以及历史上头一个由中国展商夺得的科隆“最佳展台奖”，等等等等。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14645/9acf9d77b4a9dabfb9d00c37442202a8.png_mw680water
可以说，在上线前后的短暂时间里，终末地几乎以一种横扫的姿态，迅速拿齐了索尼、苹果、谷歌三大平台巨头以及海内外核心展会的最高认可。
放到几年前，来自国内的跨端大作，在海外斩获平台大奖，或许还带有几分“工业化奇观”的新鲜感红利；但在2026年，全球市场对大体量长线游戏的审视早已彻底祛魅。
如果我们把视线从奖杯上挪开，看看今年的全球游戏市场大盘，会发现2026年的牌桌，早就发生了深层的剧变。
站在年底这个节点回看2026年的全球游戏供给端，其实会看到一幅相当割裂的图景。终末地这十个月走过的路，恰好成了观察2026年全球游戏行业风向的一个绝佳切面。
一方面，我们可以看到欧美传统重度游戏厂商在成本高压下的全面收缩。上周刚发布的GDC行业报告显示，高达34%的受访开发者在过去两年遭遇裁员，且过半数至今未能重返行业；叠加主机全线提价、超六成PC游戏时长被老游戏锁死等客观现实，西方大厂在巨额亏损风险面前纷纷退回保守的续作安全区。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14645/95bc74c77b5f5d2e09039cac95260c56.png_mw680water
高达64%的PC游戏时长依然被2019年以前的老游戏牢牢锁死
简单来讲，今年的欧美市场除了把指望全押在《GTA6》上，无论是单主机还是大型GaaS，高举高打的原创大作都陷入了漫长的空窗期。
而另一端，则是海量中小团队乃至商业大厂为了追求高杠杆率，一窝蜂扎向短平快的轻度赛道与AI管线。反映在数据上，Steam今年上线的新游数量已狂飙突破2.69万款（前年其实还只有1.8万），移动端则被微创新小游戏与合成玩法彻底占领。
这一点，无论是打开Steam被海量轻度合作与肉鸽小品刷屏的PC玩家，还是每天在手机上被副玩法买量广告包围的移动游戏用户，应该都有着极为强烈的体感。
其实何止是游戏行业，整个2026年泛文娱市场的底色，几乎都是在用极致量化的性价比去争夺用户的碎片化注意力，用AI生成与工业流水线去稀释内容的真实价值。
但凡事都有个物极必反。
当短剧、AI快餐和同质化的轻度玩法把线上空间塞满后，玩家对这种“扁平化线上娱乐”的审美疲劳也在今年达到了顶峰。
大家嘴上说着“赛博养胃”、没时间玩长游戏，身体却对高规格的重度内容产生了前所未有的饥渴。
今年《影之刃零》《鬼武者：剑之道》等在内容制作思路上相对“传统”且硬核的作品之所以能饱受好评，其实都在印证这种饥渴有多强烈。
当整个行业都在为了规避风险而追求“短平快、低精力投入”时，敢于做长线重度内容的产品，反而成了全球市场的真空地带。
所以，说了这么多，我想说的其实是——纵观2026年至今， 你能在全球市场上看到的最彻底、最“反潮流”的“重资产多端游戏”，还真的就是《明日方舟：终末地》 ，它的稀缺性恰好在于此。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14645/7e1c4041aabb9187bfc933a05744f55e.jpg_mw680water
在别人都在忙着给生产做减法、拼凑高性价比公式的2026年，鹰角在终末地上砸下的，偏偏是一种近乎“反效率”的笨功夫。
最直观的体 感 首先 来自视觉。即 便放在整个二游赛道里看，终末地这套基于写实环境基底的二次元美术，显得相当不走寻常路，细腻的写实物理材质、冷峻的现代工业风貌，以及不同版本中的“中式美学奇观”，成为了极具辨识度的审美锚点。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14645/9e26da9b0504a9bbfd51300f22d27ffd.jpg_mw680water
说句实话，如果你感受过「丹青渡」版本里那种近乎“疯狂”的视听堆料，应该就不太会意外，为什么在工业美学与视觉表现层面，终末地今年能接连得到Apple、Google以及海内外各大权威奖项的一致认可了。
就像我们之前在 Unity技术会议上的报道 所说，过去海外认同中国厂商的创新大多集中在商业模式或产能（做得快、做得多），而这次终末地带来了大量大型项目最底层的工程能力展示，在全球范围内秀了一次国产肌肉。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14645/8de34fad3dd82569e64066a8297cc503.jpg_mw680water
“所以……你住在画里？”
当然，真正让终末地在今年的供给端里显得“奢侈”的，还有重度差异化的底层玩法与关卡设计。
过去几年，主流商业化二游大作最稳妥的安全牌，基本都是“大世界平铺跑图+切人放技能”。但终末地却偏偏选了一条再来一次估计也没人敢选的险路。无论是四人同屏即时战术战斗，还是自动化工业产线，还是高密度的立体箱庭，这三个差异化模块但凡单拎出来一个，放在市面上估计都够支撑一款新游单独拿去立项了。
就拿箱庭关卡设计来说，场景好看归好看，在好看的场景里做出大量的空间拓扑、垂直高低差与动线回环，又更是一番工夫。也正因如此，你甚至能在B站上看到相当多UP主专门针对终末地各版本的地图做硬核的关卡设计拆解——这种单机味十足的讨论待遇，在过往的国产长线服务型游戏（GaaS）里显然是极为少见的。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14645/4b6c90f06343a0efccb4ae188de50de8.png_mw680water
要知道，单机化的立体箱庭在GaaS游戏里向来是个“负ROI”的深坑——它极度消耗关卡（和美术）的心血，且地图一旦被玩家跑熟，其实也很难复用，属于一次性消耗品。
在算盘打得震天响的2026年，从美术资产、底层机制到每个版本的空间关卡都维持这种重度投入，无疑是一场罕见的逆周期打法。
但也恰恰是这个打法，让它在今年略显荒芜的重度内容市场里，得到了全球玩家的认可。
那么问题来了：只要舍得砸钱、投入人力去做一款重资产游戏，就自然而然能满足全球玩家和各路评委对“精品大作”的期许了吗？
显然也不是。如果我们把获奖的滤镜摘掉、复盘一下终末地今年的历程，会发现鹰角的这场重注，其实步步都走得挺险的。
比如年初刚上线时，它就不可避免地让不少慕名而来的泛用户，在两套核心玩法体验之间感到了强烈的拉扯：冲着鹰角美术和角色剧情来的传统二游玩家，在前期漫长的基建教学和“荒野拉电线”里容易陷入迷茫。
而习惯了快节奏爽感的用户，也会对初期略显严苛的工业配平和各种基本原理产生一定抵触感。在今天这个玩家的精力比时间更值钱的年代，任何内容上的理解门槛（哪怕只是相对门槛），都很容易直接转化为社区里的负反馈。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14645/2fce1b4345dfe118467b637ad82f01d6.jpg_mw680water
基建玩家不得不学的《基建原理》
但幸运的是，终末地并没有因此变成一款曲高和寡的实验品：项目组在今年展现出了极高水准的研运执行力，通过高频的调优和超级量大管饱的内容更新，硬生生把开服初期的体验波动给收敛了回来。
我们打个比方，在现在的注意力争夺战里，现代玩家追求的本质上是“反馈/投入比”的最大化， 而过去十个月里，终末地最漂亮的操作就是“分母做减法，分子做加法”。

items.title: GTA系列封面往事：史上最深入人心的游戏封面，是怎么诞生的？
items.summary: 几年前写过 GTA系列的读书笔记 ，本周GTA6发售，再写一段关于GTA系列这套封面视觉的轶事。 如今大家熟悉的GTA这套分格封面构图，从3代开始奠定风格后一直延续至今，但它的诞生其实是一次临时救火的偶然产物。 2001

content.v: https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14648/719532cd2b35016ccb8ca10fe0109ddb.jpg_mw680water
如今大家熟悉的GTA这套分格封面构图，从3代开始奠定风格后一直延续至今，但它的诞生其实是一次临时救火的偶然产物。
2001年，英国画师Stephen Bliss接下了3代的封面设计工作。按照主创Sam Houser给出的“像007电影海报一样”的方向，Bliss花了小半年时间交出了一张漫画风格的白底原画。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14648/5810e3431dfec8b219626a8017c49a3b.jpg_mw680water
就是下面这张 ，可以看到在几栋建筑和3代的游戏logo下方，人物、枪支、飞车和爆炸的火光紧紧挤在同一张画布上 。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14648/3320d2baa0ada23f7d43c206fe39826d.png_mw680water
不过就在游戏发售前一个多月，9·11事件 发生了 。

在当时异常敏感的美国社会氛围下，这一事件触发了整个电子游戏史上最大规模的内容修改与撤架潮—— 由于北美市场的重要性， 所有和纽约、高楼、飞机沾边的游戏都被迫采取行动： 动视紧急推迟了原定于9月18日推出的《蜘蛛侠2：电光再现》，改掉了最终战里容易让人联想到世贸双子塔的建筑；世嘉的空战游戏《螺旋桨竞技场》因为允许玩家驾驶飞机在高楼附近穿行，原封面上又有飞机逼近摩天大楼的画面，事发后被无限期推迟发售并准备更换封面，最终再也没能正式上市。
即将发售的《合金装备2》结尾原本有一段巨型要塞冲入曼哈顿的戏份，小岛秀夫本人一度觉得游戏可能无法发行，甚至做好了承担责任、离开科乐美的准备。游戏当然最终还是如期上市，只是把 要塞撞入城市的部分演出做了大量的删减 。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14648/051029af74dad36217d2c2993ab72f2c.png_mw680water
相比远在海外的同行，Rockstar当时就在风暴中心，他们的纽约办公室距离世贸中心最多只有30分钟步行路程，自然更是如履薄冰，团队不仅把游戏里原本酷似纽约警车的蓝白涂装全改成了黑白熊猫色，还临时锯短了游戏里唯一一架飞机的机翼，防止玩家开着它去撞楼。
至于那张画着枪火与燃烧建筑的初版封面，更不可能让它出现在当时的美国货架上了，Rockstar 决定将原画留给英国等欧洲市场，同时要求Bliss为北美市场重做一版，尽可能隐去直接的暴力元素。
死线的时间非常短，Bliss没有时间重新创作，于是他想到了利用自己迷恋的漫画网格构图。他直接把那张画了半年的原稿拆散，挑出没那么暴力的局部裁切下来，重新塞进一个个黑色边框的格子里。只用了两个晚上，这套重组方案就成型了。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14648/adc9d866ce66f71b1a1a84372232ba80.jpg_mw680water
歪打正着的是，当角色、跑车和街景各自占据一个窗口、并置在同一平面上时，这套封面变成了一组精妙的视觉索引。玩家的视线可以在格子里四处游走，这也恰恰神还原了GTA开放世界的精髓。再加上 Bliss 特意参考的早期邦德电影和cult经典《战士帮》海报的底色，属于GTA的视觉招牌就此立住，之后也成了这一系列的视觉符号：无论每一作的剧情怎么变，这种网格构图的封面都保持了下来。

仅仅一年后，这套方格就在《罪恶都市》里迎来了第一次华丽变身，被 Bliss涂满了自己最着迷的80年代霓虹。对这位英国画师来说，作为原型的迈阿密简直像个外星世界——他在英国和欧洲从没见过满街粉红与浅蓝色的酒店，整座城市活脱脱就是一部《疤面煞星》般的电影。去迈阿密时，他甚至发现当地靶场里能直接预订一份“《疤面煞星》套餐”，把电影主角用过的枪挨个打上一遍。这种荒诞又迷人的纸醉金迷，被他悉数装进了《罪恶都市》的黑框里，成了他自己最偏爱的一代作品。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14648/f9b639e5bfa4c248abb4a63ace485578.jpg_mw680water
到了资料片《圣安地列斯》，更多画师加入进来。为了捕捉加州特有的迷蒙日光，团队开始在色彩上做文章，当时新加入的画家Steven Olds带来了一手绝活：让强烈的阳光融进人物侧脸，同时在暗部边缘勾出一道锐利的反射光。 这种光影技法让Bliss印象极深，他后来多次表示Olds教给他的东西让自己的画技进步了一大截。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14648/6aa0cd8bc73bd7bf1be3a7391d5a5614.png_mw680water
等到了 五代， Steven Olds 等人已经离开， 画笔已经交接到了早年就与他并肩作战的Anthony Macbain、Roxie Vizcarra和新一代美术团队手中 ，在他们笔下，延续多年的分格传统被注入了更细腻的写实肌理，洛圣都的阳光也变得更加明艳刺眼。
https://alioss.yystv.cn/doc/14648/4a78905cfccbceac7b00181d9963856c.jpg_mw680water
只是这套视觉语言实在太深入人心，以至于在Bliss离开Rockstar多年后，在一些漫展和活动上还是常有热情的粉丝拿着《GTA V》的海报跑到他面前求签名。每次遇到这种场面，这位当年用两个通宵救急的画师都得哭笑不得地先跟对方解释半天：这真不是我画的。

content.v: And it's more affordable than Nintendo's.

8BitDo, known for its work in providing excellent retro-inspired controllers for modern systems, has announced the GC Bluetooth Gamepad to celebrate the GameCube's 25th anniversary. It's currently scheduled to launch on 10th December 2026 .

Compatible with Switch, Switch 2, and Windows, the GC controller maintains the core shape and layout of the iconic GameCube pad, but adds in a bunch of modern upgrades like TMR sticks and Hall Effect triggers. Priced at $49.99 , it undercuts Nintendo's official offering by $20 and is available for pre-order now.
